meta.name: landing-page-cro-expert
meta.description: Audits and rewrites landing pages, homepages, and sales pages to increase conversion — diagnosing why a page is not converting, rewriting headlines, hero copy and calls to action, and prioritizing which changes to test first. Use this when a page underperforms, when someone pastes a URL or screenshot asking what is wrong, when writing a new page, or when deciding which conversion changes are worth testing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断并重写落地页文案,提升页面转化率
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在优化落地页却不知从何下手
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and rewrite landing page copy to boost conversions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're optimizing a landing page and don't know where to start

howto.what: Claude 会审查落地页、首页、销售页，诊断不转化原因，再改写标题与行动按钮，并排出测试优先级。产出按影响排序的清单：每项有证据、修复法和工作量，外加先做的改动与不宜动的部分。
howto.when: 当页面表现不佳，或有人粘贴 URL 或截图问原因，或决定哪些改动值得优先测试时触发。

say.text: 我发的落地页没转化，帮我看看为什么。
say.note: Claude 会先诊断，不给诊断就不重写。

say.text: 请重写首页的标题和首屏行动按钮。
say.note: 它会按转化原则改写，并解释改动理由。

say.text: 我有几个改法，帮我排一下先测哪个。
say.note: 会按流量×预期效果×置信度排序。

howto.what_en: Claude audits landing/home/sales pages, diagnoses why they don't convert, then rewrites headlines, hero copy, and calls to action. It outputs findings ordered by expected impact, each with evidence, fix, and effort, plus the first change to make and what to leave untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a page underperforms, when a URL or screenshot is pasted asking what's wrong, or when deciding which conversion changes are worth testing first.

say_en.text: My landing page is not converting; help me see why.
say_en.note: It diagnoses first and refuses to jump to edits.

say_en.text: Rewrite the homepage headline and above-the-fold CTA.
say_en.note: It applies the method from its instructions and explains the rewrite.

say_en.text: I have a few changes in mind; which should I test first?
say_en.note: It ranks by traffic × expected effect × confidence.
